headline: Kushtia: 2 youths killed in clash over dominance
summary: Two young men were hacked to death following a violent confrontation between two opposing groups in Kushtia.
details: Two young men were killed after a violent clash broke out between two opposing groups in Kushtia.
The conflict reportedly stemmed from a dispute over local dominance and influence in the area.
The victims were hacked to death during the clash, leading to a tense atmosphere in the locality.
Local authorities are investigating the matter to ensure law and order is maintained in the region.
